description: A terminal on this host (Multiplex's, baudelib.hostterminal): a program run in a pty here, or attach: one already running here seen again. One a connection: its answers are terminal_opened, then terminal_out as the program writes (first, on attach, what it wrote lately) and terminal_end once it ends. The connection going leaves the program running a while (TERMINAL_KEEP_S) to be attached to again.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

argv.description: What to run: the user's login shell if none.

cwd.description: The folder it starts in: the home folder if none.

title.description: What it's called till its program names it.

attach.description: A terminal running here (terminals' id), seen again instead of a new one.
